svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Web application on Google Cloud
svg.desc: Web application on Google Cloud. 8 components in 3 groups. Connections: Users to Cloud Load Balancing (HTTPS); Cloud Armor to Cloud Load Balancing; Cloud CDN to Cloud Load Balancing; Cloud Load Balancing to Cloud Run; Cloud Run to Cloud SQL; Cloud Run to Memorystore; Cloud Run to Secret Manager.

text.tspan: A global load balancer with Cloud CDN and Cloud Armor in front of Cloud Run, backed by Cloud SQL and Memorystore
